items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released APSB26-153 addressing 11 vulnerabilities, including five critical ones. CVE-2026-103849 (CVSS 10.0) allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code, and CVE-2026-92909 (CVSS 9.8) affects Adobe Commerce B2B.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. This update addresses issues that could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE (StyleSmuggler) under active attack
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a zero-day vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) in Magento and Adobe Commerce that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution. Attacks began on September 4th, and Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) on September 7th.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass access controls and gain elevated privileges, potentially leading to customer account takeover. It was addressed in the August 2026 security update (APSB26-92) and is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.title: Adobe patches critical Magento account takeover
items.summary: Adobe released isolated patch files for APSB26-92, fixing seven vulnerabilities, five of which are critical. This includes CVE-2026-71362, an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin addresses 14 vulnerabilities, marking the first month-stamped releases for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.
